name: GaGS
aliases: Gaussian Voxelization with Sparse Convolution for Deformation
definition: A method that devises the voxelization of a set of Gaussian distributions, followed by the use of sparse convolutions to extract geometry-aware features, which are then utilized for deformation learning.
summary: GaGS learns spatial-temporal deformation of 3D Gaussians by combining positional and local geometric features via sparse convolutions, distinguishing itself from implicit deformation fields.
